headlines.title: ‘They Get You Coming In, They Get You Going Out’: Clark’s Fix for T-Mobile’s Exit Bill Trap
headlines.summary: T-Mobile billed Luke in Virginia for an extra month after he cancelled, and the supervisor refused to budge. Clark Howard says carriers have engineered this trap into every billing cycle, but a simple date on your calendar closes it.

headlines.title: T Mobile US (TMUS) Rolls Out Nationwide AI Powered Network Automation
headlines.summary: T-Mobile US (NasdaqGS:TMUS) introduced nationwide AI-powered network automation tools AutoPilot and Dynamic CX, focused on real-time resilience. AutoPilot uses AI to automate network configuration and traffic routing during disruptions and periods of heavy demand. Dynamic CX applies AI to monitor service quality and adjust network resources to support customer experience during high-usage events.

headlines.title: T-Mobile quietly plans new perks to keep customers from switching
headlines.summary: T-Mobile is preparing to give customers more reasons to stay, with new free perks that could change the value of its wireless plans.

headlines.title: Should You Bet on TMUS After Dividend Hike Amid Macro Uncertainty?
headlines.summary: T-Mobile's 15% dividend hike, stronger cash flow, and service revenue growth bolster its case, while competition, macro pressures and $84.6B in debt pose risks.

headlines.title: U-wifi Announces Strategic Program With T-Mobile to Expand Affordable Internet Access Nationwide
headlines.summary: U-wifi, a next-generation 5G home and business internet provider delivering fast, reliable whole-home Wi-Fi announced today a Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) agreement with T-Mobile to power its nationwide program focused on addressing the growing internet affordability crisis following the expiration of the FCC Affordable Connectivity Program (ACP).

description: T-Mobile US, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides wireless communications services in the United States, Puerto Rico, and the United States Virgin Islands. The company offers voice, messaging, and data services to postpaid, prepaid, and wholesale and other services customers. It also provides wireless devices, including smartphones, wearables, tablets, home broadband gateways, headsets, and other mobile communication devices, as well as accessories; financing through equipment installment plans; reinsurance for device insurance policies and extended warranty contracts. The company offers services under the T-Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile, and Mint Mobile brands through its owned and operated retail stores, customer care channels, national retailers, and its websites, as well as through T-Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile, and Mint Mobile apps. It also sells devices to dealers and other third-party distributors for resale through independent third-party retail outlets and various third-party websites. It has 700 MHz wireless spectrum licenses. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Bellevue, Washington. T-Mobile US, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Deutsche Telekom AG.
